<!--
Thank you. Fill in what you can; a partial report is better than none. The
fields under "Your setup" are the ones that most often decide whether a bug
can be reproduced at all, so please do not skip them.

Before filing: read the Safety section of the README. The bot stopping early
and often is by design and is not a bug. The bot getting your character hurt
or killed when a human would have stopped IS a bug, and is the kind of report
this project most wants.
-->
